review_method: Half-second contact sheet plus frames around candidate cuts; not a frame-by-frame count of animation drawings

shots.action: Hand on chest; small gesture changes
Hands rise to mouth, lower; head turns; framing shifts to include another character
shots.camera: Visible reframing; not counted as a cut

notes: Semantic action descriptions are visual observations, not estimated animation FPS. Fine timing inside shots remains approximate. Audio beats not manually reviewed.
